concept: The land is measured to the acre and the power draw is not measured at all, so the one number that decides whether a Fairbanks bill goes up or down is the one nobody has published. Ask for the date it will be, not for the number.

hook.frame1: a copper-rimmed ruled offer card slamming onto birch-gold ground, every row cascading in at once, and by 1.4s one row alone left a crawling dashed void
hook.headline: ONE ROW IS BLANK
hook.loopback: the button returns to the same card with the same birch leaves drifting past it, every row solid except the one that started the film blank, and the pen hovering over it
hook.pattern_note: a ruled form fills in row by row exactly as expected, and then one row does not, which is the anomaly, and the question it raises is what belonged in it. Gate 0B found the board had withheld that row until 19.8s, three or four scroll decisions past the one that mattered, so it now lands at 1.4s.

reveals.what: the traced parcel seen against the whole town, to scale
the statement card unfolds into the cost stack in one continuous move
the fillable DATE PUBLISHED row appears under the unfillable MEGAWATTS row

open_loop.what: the POWER DEMAND row arrives and does not fill, and the film refuses to resolve it until the diagram that needs it slams between two answers

open_loop_2.what: Murkowski names POWER rather than LAND, and the film withholds what power actually costs a town until the data center arrives carrying an empty plate

states.state: slams down and every row cascades in
one row alone refuses to fill
a NO AWARD stamp hangs over it without landing, so not one row on it is final
an unsigned lease lies open beside it with a blank terms page, and the borough's PAUSE chip stops short of the signature line
unfolds into the cost stack and splits into wires and fuel
the fuel half reaches for the deciding slot and is kicked back, and the slot reads NOT DISCLOSED
back to a card beside that same unsigned lease, every row solid but one, and the blank row now labelled with a DATE a person could actually ask for

divergence_note: Against 2026-09-14 (bright ultramarine and mango, orbital-aerial, vertical-descent, instrument-as-subject) and 2026-09-19 (powerhouse green and sodium amber, macro-closeup, single-object-void, radial-emanate, structure-as-subject) this film is a FRONTAL DOCUMENT in split-compare, its motion vector is DIVIDE-AND-SETTLE which no recent film has used, its hero treatment is DOCUMENT-AS-SUBJECT which is new, and its palette shares no colour role with either. The shape grammar is ruled form against unruled land, which is the argument drawn rather than a style note.
